title: data-pipeline config validator
description: Validates configuration inputs for the data-pipeline skill

action.description: What the user wants to do with or to the pipeline

source_description.description: Free-text description of data sources (databases, APIs, files, streams)

target_platform.description: Target data warehouse or lakehouse platform

paradigm.description: Processing paradigm; auto lets the skill recommend one

transformation_framework.description: Framework for transformations; auto lets the skill recommend one

orchestrator.description: Orchestration tool; auto lets the skill recommend one

latency_requirement.description: How fresh the data needs to be

existing_dag_path.description: Path to an existing DAG or pipeline file for review or optimization

existing_dbt_project.description: Path to an existing dbt project root for review

include_quality_checks.description: Whether to include data quality check recommendations

include_monitoring.description: Whether to include monitoring and alerting recommendations

schema_pattern.description: Target schema design pattern; auto lets the skill recommend one
